description: This file defines the interface and class for MaintenanceManager, a plugin class in a WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes enums, macros, class declarations, method prototypes, and includes for external dependencies related to maintenance tasks, event handling, and system interactions.

classes.name: MaintenanceManager
classes.description: A plugin class responsible for handling maintenance operations, event management, and system interactions within the WPEFramework. It supports initialization, deinitialization, event handling, and exposes several maintenance-related RPC methods.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the MaintenanceManager plugin with the given service context.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns static information about the plugin.

methods.name: runScript
methods.description: Executes a system script with arguments and captures output or errors.

methods.name: onMaintenanceStatusChange
methods.description: Triggers when maintenance status changes, notifying subscribed clients.

methods.name: getMaintenanceActivityStatus
methods.description: RPC method to retrieve current maintenance activity status.

methods.name: getMaintenanceStartTime
methods.description: RPC method to retrieve the start time of maintenance.

methods.name: setMaintenanceMode
methods.description: RPC method to set the maintenance mode.

methods.name: stopMaintenance
methods.description: RPC method to stop ongoing maintenance.

methods.name: getMaintenanceMode
methods.description: RPC method to query current maintenance mode.
